content.short: GIGA DEX offers concentrated and classic liquidity pools on Robinhood Chain.
content.description: GIGA DEX runs both concentrated and constant-product pools on Robinhood Chain, letting liquidity providers choose between capital efficiency and the simpler passive position. Offering both matters more on a chain trading tokenized equities, where some pairs move within tight ranges and others do not.
